title: Creating a risk with likelihood/impact scores computes and displays the correct inherent risk level end-to-end
description: Exercises POST /organizations/:orgId/risks through to the /risk-register/[id] detail page, verifying the server-computed score/level (not a client-side guess) is what renders.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with risk.create permission
steps: Navigate to /risk-register and open the create-risk form
Fill in name, description, category='cybersecurity', riskType='vulnerability', inherentRisk likelihood=5, impact=4
Submit the form
Open the created risk's detail page at /risk-register/[id]
expectedResult: Risk is created with riskId RISK-YYYY-NNNN, inherentRisk.score=20 and level='critical' both on the API response and rendered on the detail page's assessment panel.

title: Promoting a module risk from the triage queue creates a governed risk register entry linked back to the source finding
description: Covers the full auto-promotion path shown in /risk-center/risk-triage and /risk-center/module-risks: a pending candidate from one of the 9 integration services (cloud-posture, compliance, audit, policy, trust-vault, evidence, pcl, connector, integration) becomes a real Risk with mappings.controls/frameworks/uclControls pre-populated from the source event's facts.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with risk.approve permission
A pending module risk exists with sourceState='active', currentSignal.status='FAIL', policyDecision.material=true
steps: Navigate to /risk-center/risk-triage
Locate the pending candidate and click 'Promote to Register'
Confirm the target project matches the candidate's project
Navigate to /risk-register and locate the newly created risk
expectedResult: A new risk (riskId RISK-YYYY-NNNN, riskCode RK-<PROJECT>-<seq>) appears in the register with source.sourceType/sourceModule populated and, where the event carried control/UCL facts, mappings.controls and mappings.uclControls pre-filled. The module risk's status flips to 'added' and disappears from the pending triage queue.

title: Submitting and approving a risk acceptance request updates status and surfaces on the governance dashboard
description: Follows the full acceptance workflow: request submission with a named approver, the approver's decision, and the resulting visibility in /risk-center/governance's pendingApprovals / expiringAcceptances panels.
preconditions: Two users: a requester and a named approver
steps: As the requester, open the risk detail page and submit an acceptance request with a 50+ character justification, a validUntil date, and the approver's user as approverIds
Confirm the risk shows 'Acceptance Pending' and appears under /risk-center/governance pendingApprovals
As the approver, open the pending request and approve it with comments
Reload the risk detail page
expectedResult: acceptance.status transitions pending -> approved, the risk appears in the accepted-risks list (/risk-center or accepted-risks summary) with the correct validUntil, and pendingApprovals on the governance dashboard decrements.

title: Evidence attached to a risk transitions through fresh -> aging -> stale and surfaces in the risk-center evidence view
description: Exercises freshnessConfig-driven staleness classification (default freshDays=30, agingDays=60, staleDays=90) end-to-end from upload through the /risk-center/evidence page's gap/coverage widgets.
preconditions: A risk with no existing evidence
steps: Upload a document as risk evidence with the default freshnessConfig
Immediately check /risk-center/evidence — confirm the item shows 'fresh'
Simulate the passage of 65 days (or seed an evidence record with uploadedAt 65 days in the past)
Reload /risk-center/evidence
expectedResult: The evidence item's currentFreshness recalculates to 'aging' (60-89 days) and the risk-center evidence coverage/gap widget reflects it as no longer 'fresh', without requiring the evidence to be re-uploaded.

title: Escalating a risk records an escalation entry and updates the governance escalatedRisks panel
preconditions: A second user to escalate to
steps: On the risk detail page, use the escalate action, selecting the target user, level=2, and a reason of 10+ characters
Confirm the escalated-to user receives an in-app notification
Navigate to /risk-center/governance
expectedResult: The risk's escalationHistory shows the new entry with level=2 and the correct escalatedTo/escalatedBy; the governance dashboard's escalatedRisks list includes the risk with escalationLevel='L2'.

title: Heat map and top risks widgets on the risk-center dashboard reflect the current inherent risk distribution
description: Validates /risk-center's heatmapDistribution (keyed '${likelihood}-${impact}') and topRisks against the actual risks seeded for the project.
preconditions: Project has at least one risk at likelihood=5/impact=5 and one at likelihood=2/impact=2
steps: Navigate to /risk-center
Locate the heat map cell for likelihood=5, impact=5
Locate the top risks widget
expectedResult: The 5-5 heat map cell count matches the number of risks with that exact likelihood/impact pair, and the top risks list is ordered by inherentRisk.score descending with the critical risk surfaced first.

title: AI Predictions panel content is deterministic and reproducible for an unchanged risk posture
description: RiskCenterService.computeRuleBasedPredictions() is rule-based (not an LLM call) — driven synchronously off already-fetched stats/posture/treatment/drift/governance/findings. Re-fetching the dashboard with no underlying data change must return the same predictions, confirming /risk-center/ai-predictions isn't presenting non-deterministic or fabricated content as 'AI'.
steps: Load /risk-center/ai-predictions and record the displayed predictions (type, confidence, recommendation, timeframe)
Reload the page twice more within the 5-minute dashboard cache TTL without changing any risk data
expectedResult: All three loads show identical predictions — confirming the output is deterministic rule evaluation, not a per-request generative call that could hallucinate varying content.

title: Completing a treatment plan's final milestone closes the loop from /risk-center/treatments through to residual score display
preconditions: A risk in phase 'mitigation' with a treatment plan containing one open milestone at 90% progress
steps: Navigate to /risk-center/treatments and open the risk's treatment plan
Mark the remaining milestone as 100% complete
Move the risk's phase to 'monitoring'
Open the risk detail page's assessment tab
expectedResult: Treatment status shows 'completed' with a completedDate, the treatment dashboard's 'completed' count increments, and the residual risk score/level reflects the post-treatment likelihood/impact entered at assessment update.
